records.name: MechShowcase
records.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset for original open-source RTS sample. A single original utilitarian gray scout ground mech, full body standing three quarter view, blue optical sensor, balanced mechanical limbs, plain dark navy hangar background. Portrait composition 3:4. Only unit artwork, no frame, no labels, no UI. Match the central mech in the reference. Reference is approved page design STYLE ONLY, extract an independently rendered asset, NOT the whole page. Navy #06111D cyan #45C9D8 amber #D89A32. No existing franchises, insignia, watermarks, numbers or pseudo text. High readability at game UI scale.
